rules.keyword_note: PYRION convention: a quote can carry a tag only if it contains one of these word stems. Extinction limits count as prevention, not automatically as suppression.

indirect: was instead used to detect dust

rules.matching: Word for word; only runs of whitespace (line breaks in the PSI JSON) are read as one space.
rules.strength: PYRION convention. direct: the investigation is named in the challenge's fire-safety text (Background, or the 'Other investigations in PSI' bullets). fundamental: not named there, and its own PSI record describes the work as fundamental. indirect: the rest; the challenge says such investigations are relevant 'just not as strongly or directly'. Exception: DAFT / DAFT-2 is named only because a SAME smoke-detection instrument 'was instead used to detect dust' there, so it is indirect.
